scenario.title: The Unexpected Farewell
scenario.context: At a bustling community center during a farewell party for a beloved yoga teacher
scenario.description: A community center is hosting a farewell party for an adored yoga teacher, Mei, who is moving to another city. Mei's longtime student and friend, Yara, approaches her to wish her well and share her feelings about the departure.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Empathetic, caring, and expressive. Values building and maintaining strong interpersonal relationships.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Emotionally intelligent, warm, and receptive. Understands the importance of expressing gratitude and acknowledging others' feelings in maintaining relationships.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Emotionally reactive in a defensive way. Tends to dismiss or minimize others' feelings and avoid emotional conversations.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Emotionally reactive in an anxious way. Overwhelmed by others' emotions, tends to shut down or withdraw from emotional conversations.
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: High EQ - Emotionally intelligent, warm, and receptive. Understands the importance of expressing gratitude and acknowledging others' feelings in maintaining relationships.
scenario.speaker2_persona_low: Low EQ - Emotionally reactive in a defensive way. Tends to dismiss or minimize others' feelings and avoid emotional conversations.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Mei, I can't believe you're moving away. I'm really going to miss our sessions.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: I know, Yara. It's not an easy decision for me either.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: You've been such a positive influence in my life. I feel like I'm losing a friend and a mentor.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: And you've been an incredible student and friend, Yara. I'm so grateful for our time together.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I guess all good things must come to an end. But promise we'll stay in touch?

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Absolutely, Yara. This isn't a goodbye, but a see you later.
